title: Local OTLP receiver conformance vector (ADR-0011)
description: One black-box case for the local OTLP/HTTP JSON metrics receiver of the javi collector (JD-C01), derived from ADR-0011, JGR spec v0.1, the OTLP specification and the Claude Code monitoring documentation. See README.md for runner semantics.

contract.description: Contract text the expectation is derived from (ADR-0011 section, OTLP spec section, spec section, Claude Code docs).

ambiguities.description: README ambiguity ids (A1, A2, ...) whose chosen interpretation this vector relies on.

steps.description: Requests sent in order to ONE receiver instance (no restart between steps).

forbiddenStrings.description: Strings that MUST NOT occur in any spooled or delivered byte (README: Forbidden strings), in addition to the global list.

identityGroup.description: Scope of idLabel comparison across vectors. null: labels are compared within this vector only.

headers.description: Request headers (lower-case names), sent exactly. $PORT, $SECRET and $WRONG_SECRET are substituted inside values. Content-Encoding: gzip is added when gzip is true and no content-encoding is listed.

body.description: JSON body (an OTLP ExportMetricsServiceRequest or a deliberately invalid value), serialized compactly by the runner.

rawBody.description: Exact UTF-8 body string; used instead of body.

bodyPadBytes.description: Pad the serialized body with ASCII spaces (0x20) at the end until it is at least this many bytes, before gzip.

matcher.description: A string means exact equality. An object combines the listed checks.

usageDelta.description: Expected usage_delta (ADR-0011 Mapping). Every counter is listed; README: Event comparison says how an absent counter compares.

idLabel.description: Same label within the scope (vector or identityGroup) means equal event_id; different labels mean different event_id.

session.description: Raw OTel session.id; the event's thread_ref MUST equal opaqueRef('cc', session, salt).

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 instant the event's occurred_at MUST equal (the point's timeUnixNano).

headers.description: Response header matchers; names compared case-insensitively; unlisted headers are not checked.

body.description: Exact JSON value of the parsed response body; null means not checked.

events.description: usage.reported events whose event_id first appears after this step (README: Event observation). Order-insensitive.

droppedUnattributed.description: Matcher on the increase of the receiver's unattributed-drop counter caused by this step; null means not checked.
